response.sql: WITH state_bases AS (SELECT c.state_county_province, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_base FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.state_county_province), state_shares AS (SELECT account_base, account_base * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(account_base) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM state_bases), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM state_shares) SELECT SUM(s.account_base) AS combined_account_base, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - b.average_share) AS average_share_above_average FROM state_shares s CROSS JOIN benchmark b WHERE s.share > b.average_share
